_about: Each status's effects words and legacy keys BEFORE the stage-2b migration (captured by tools/migrate_statuses.py --capture-words). A record; never rewritten.

legacy._comment: What standing in water does to you: lightning finds you more easily. Applied by wet ground at the start of each turn you begin on it (CombatManager._process_terrain_effects), so it lasts through the round in which an enemy could exploit it and lapses a turn after you step out. Lightning only, not ice: water conducts, and that makes wet ground a set-up an Air caster can cash in, rather than a Water caster's own combo with itself. 25% is a first-pass balance number — modest because the ground already slows you.
